thesis: Firefly Aerospace Inc. is a Nasdaq-listed U.S. space and defense technology company selling end-to-end mission solutions: small and medium launch (Alpha and Eclipse rockets), spacecraft (Blue Ghost lunar lander and Elytra orbital vehicles), and defense software and sensing (SciTec, acquired October 2025). **[Fact]** Customers are primarily U.S. national security agencies, NASA, and prime contractors. **[Fact]** FY2025 revenue was **$159.9 million** (+163% versus **$60.8 million** in FY2024). **[Fact]** Q1 2026 revenue was **$80.9 million** (+45% year-over-year versus **$55.9 million**). **[Fact]** The company had **1,409 employees** at December 31, 2025, including **436** with active national security clearances (10-K Item 1).
why_market_wrong: **Predictive attribute:** backlog versus burn (milestone cash collections versus operating losses).
